notes: «وروى بعضهم» is a different transmitter for the same report: a variant group. «قال قال أبو بكر» after Abu Nadra: whether Abu Bakr is a transmitter of the saying or the Tirmidhi-style commentator is not settled by the text, so he is not added and needs_ruling is set (rule 6, rule 11). «وهذا أصح» and «ولم يذكر فيه عن أبي سعيد» are the compiler's remarks.
